# Plants Care Database

> Structured knowledge base for indoor plant care with calculators, diagnostics, and soil/water/feeding protocols. Not just a website — a complete care system for 26 houseplants, designed for practical daily use.

## Purpose

This is a data-driven plant care system. All plant data lives in YAML files and is rendered into a multilingual static site (RU/EN/HE). The system covers the full care cycle: soil composition, water chemistry (RO + CalMag), lighting requirements, feeding schedules, diagnostics, and propagation.

## Constraints & Assumptions

- All water is RO (reverse osmosis) + CalMag remineralization. Tap water is never used.
- 3 water groups: A (sensitive, PPM 80±5), B (standard, PPM 120±10), C (hardy, PPM 150±10).
- 14 soil mixes with exact component percentages. Each plant is assigned a specific mix.
- 4 feeding groups: aroids, sensitive, orchids, general houseplants.
- Wick watering is tracked per plant (compatible / not recommended).
- Static site generated with Jinja2 + YAML → HTML, deployed via GitHub Pages.
- 3 languages: Russian (primary), English, Hebrew.

## Entry Points (start here)

1. **Plant Catalog** → full care card per plant (lighting, watering, soil, feeding, water group, risks)
2. **Soil Mixes** → 14 recipes with exact percentages, which plants use which mix
3. **Water Groups** → PPM/pH targets per group, plant assignments
4. **Water Mixer** → calculator for mixing RO water with CalMag and fertilizers
5. **Plant Diagnostics** → symptom → cause → action per plant

## Data Files (priority order for machine reading)

1. `plants.yaml` — **PRIMARY**. 26 plants with: soil mix number, water group, feeding group, lighting (lux range), watering method/frequency, humidity, risks, care notes, wick watering compatibility. This is the single source of truth for all plant data.
2. `water-requirements.yaml` — water groups (A/B/C) with target PPM, allowed deviation, pH range. Individual requirements per plant with sensitivity level.
3. `soil-mixes.yaml` — 14 mixes. Each has: composition (components + percentages), variants (A/B for different component availability), notes. Includes wick-watering variants.
4. `fertilizers.yaml` — 8 products (4 fertilizers + 4 additives). Feeding matrix maps feeding_group × fertilizer → dose. PPM limits, stop conditions, seasonal schedules.
5. `facts-problems.yaml` — common symptoms dictionary (9 entries) + per-plant diagnostics (symptom, causes, severity, actions) + fun facts.
6. `image-map.yaml` — maps plant IDs to image file paths.
7. `data/i18n/{ru,en,he}.yaml` — all UI text translations.

## Pages

- [Plant Catalog](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/plants-catalog.html): Full care cards for 26 plants.
- [Water Groups](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/water-groups.html): Group A (PPM 80±5, pH 5.8-6.3), Group B (PPM 120±10, pH 6.0-6.5), Group C (PPM 150±10, pH 6.2-6.7).
- [Lighting Groups](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/lighting-groups.html): Low (2000-5000 lux), Medium (5000-9000 lux), Bright (9000-10000+ lux).
- [Soil Mixes](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/soil-groups.html): 14 recipes with percentage and parts ratios.
- [Feeding Guide](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/feeding-guide.html): Fertilizer schedules by season and plant group.
- [Water Mixer](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/water-mixer.html): RO water mixing calculator with PPM/pH targets.
- [Plant Problems](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/plant-problems.html): Diagnostics — symptom → cause → action.
- [Propagation](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/propagation.html): Propagation methods per plant.
- [Seasonal Care](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/seasonal-care.html): Season-specific care adjustments.
- [Pests & Diseases](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/pests-diseases.html): Pest identification and treatment.
- [My Products](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/my-products.html): 8 fertilizers/additives with dosing.
- [Watering Tracker](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/watering-tracker.html): Watering log per canister group.

## Plant Collection (26 plants)

Aroids: Monstera deliciosa, Monstera adansonii, Philodendron Imperial Green, Philodendron Selloum, Philodendron Xanadu, Epipremnum aureum, Spathiphyllum, Aglaonema, Alocasia amazonica, Alocasia Frydek, Anthurium andraeanum, Anthurium clarinervium.
Prayer plants: Calathea lancifolia, Calathea ornata.
Palms & Dracaenas: Dracaena marginata, Dracaena fragrans, Chamaedorea.
Other: Guzmania, Chlorophytum comosum, Begonia maculata, Phalaenopsis, Codiaeum (Croton), Nephrolepis, Sansevieria, Zamioculcas, Schlumbergera.

## Water Groups Quick Reference

| Group | Target PPM | Deviation | pH Range | Sensitivity | Plants |
|-------|-----------|-----------|----------|-------------|--------|
| A | 80 | ±5 | 5.8-6.3 | Very high | Calatheas, Alocasias, Anthuriums, Spathiphyllum, Orchid, Guzmania, Fern |
| B | 120 | ±10 | 6.0-6.5 | Medium | Monsteras, Philodendrons, Epipremnum, Aglaonema, Begonia, Chamaedorea, Chlorophytum |
| C | 150 | ±10 | 6.2-6.7 | Low | Dracaenas, Croton, Sansevieria, Zamioculcas, Schlumbergera |

## Feeding Groups Quick Reference

| Group | Fertilizers allowed | Plants |
|-------|-------------------|--------|
| aroids | Universal full, Flowering full, Multicote OK | Monsteras, Philodendrons, Epipremnum, Aglaonema |
| sensitive | Universal 1/4 only | Calatheas, Alocasias, Anthuriums, Guzmania, Fern |
| orchids | Universal 1/8, Orchid fertilizer for bloom | Phalaenopsis |
| general_houseplants | Universal full, Flowering full, Multicote OK | Begonia, Dracaenas, Croton, Sansevieria, Zamioculcas, Schlumbergera, Chamaedorea, Chlorophytum |
